svg.metadata: Target and surrounding national geometry: Natural Earth 1:10m cultural vectors, public domain, WGS84, via LonnyGomes/CountryGeoJSONCollection PRY/ARG/BOL/BRA GeoJSON; reframed 2026-09-26 as a close landlocked-country view so Paraguay fills the map, with limited surrounding-country context and no sea treatment.
